# SpeedOfSound <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SpeedOfSound:Void meters:Float32, fade_ms:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `meters` | In | Float32 | required | Meters per second, `340` (the speed in air) until it is changed. It has to be above 0, anything else is a runtime error. |
| `fade_ms` | In | Int32 | `0` | How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new value. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Changes how fast sound travels for the doppler shift, in meters per second. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* [CreateListener](CreateListener) does not change it. [GetSpeedOfSound](GetSpeedOfSound) tells the value.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; Under water, sound is more than four times as fast as in air.
SpeedOfSound 1480, 500
```
